SETUP_WELCOME_TITLE: Bring your music to the stream.
SETUP_WELCOME_DESC: Connect your player, link your chat, and check your first song request.
SETUP_ACCOUNT_DESC: Request+ sign-in and streaming account links are separate connections. Check both here.
SETUP_MUSIC_DESC: Selecting a service does not install or connect its desktop player. Follow the steps, then play a song.
SETUP_RULES_DESC: Your existing choices are kept. Review these controls, then choose Next to save them.
SETUP_OVERLAY_TITLE: Put the song on your stream.
SETUP_OVERLAY_DESC: The overlay is a local HTML file. Add it to OBS Studio or Streamlabs on this computer.
SETUP_TEST_DESC: Setup is complete only after the checks pass and you confirm seeing the requested song.
SETUP_LOAD_FAILED: Your settings could not be loaded. Retry before making changes.
SETUP_ACTION_FAILED: That action failed. Check the connection and try again.
SETUP_SAVE_FAILED: Your changes could not be saved. Stay here and retry; setup has not been completed.
SETUP_FINISH_FAILED: Setup could not finish. Check connections and retry, or save and continue later.
SETUP_OUTCOME_DESC: We will follow a song from your chat to your music player and your overlay. Each check reflects an actual connection.
SETUP_BEFORE_DESC: Your Request+ account, a supported desktop music player, your streaming account, and OBS Studio or Streamlabs. You can pause setup at any time.
SETUP_LATER_HINT: Save and continue later opens the client with your saved choices. Unfinished setup returns on your next launch; you can also reopen it in Settings.
SETUP_LOGIN_FAILED: Sign-in could not open. Try again, and complete sign-in in your browser.
SETUP_LOGIN_HINT: Complete sign-in in your browser, allow it to open Request+, then return here. Your account refreshes automatically.
SETUP_CHANNELS_HINT: Link at least one streaming account in the dashboard. A linked account alone does not prove the bot can read chat; we test that at the end.
SETUP_CONNECTIONS_FAILED: Account links could not be checked. Refresh to retry.
SETUP_GUIDE_SPOTIFY:
1. Install Spotify Desktop and Spicetify. The web player and mobile apps are not supported.
2. In Spotify, open Spicetify Marketplace (the shopping cart), search for Request+, and install the extension. Use Load more if it is not listed yet.
3. Reload Spotify when prompted, then play a song. Keep Spotify and Request+ open.
SETUP_GUIDE_YOUTUBE:
1. Open Pear Desktop for YouTube Music.
2. Enable its API server and use port 26538.
3. Approve Request+ when Pear asks, then play a song.
SETUP_GUIDE_APPLE:
1. Open Cider and sign in with an active Apple Music subscription. Cider is a separate paid app.
2. Cider 3: install and enable the Request+ plugin using the guide. Enter a Cider API token below if your setup requires one.
3. Cider 4: choose version 4 below, click Connect, and approve the prompt in Cider.
4. Enable the Cider API on port 10767 and play a song.
SETUP_GUIDE_SOUNDCLOUD:
1. Open SoundCloud with BetterSoundCloud or a custom JavaScript loader.
2. Follow the guide to load the Request+ SoundCloud bridge, keeping Request+ and the SoundCloud tab open.
3. Play a public track. Requests need full SoundCloud track links; text search is not supported. This integration is experimental.
SETUP_PLAY_HINT: Apply your choice, then play a song. This check passes when Request+ receives track information. If it stays waiting, check the player, extension, port, and authorization above.
SETUP_OBS_1: In Sources, add a Browser source and give it a name such as Request+.
SETUP_OBS_2: Enable Local file, then browse to the file below. This is a file path, not a web URL.
SETUP_OBS_3: Start with a width of 800 and height of 260. Adjust to fit your theme, keep the source visible, and play music.
SETUP_PREVIEW_HINT: This preview uses your actual overlay and current song. It does not count as an OBS connection. The overlay can hide while music is paused. Keep Request+ running during your stream.
SETUP_OVERLAY_CONFIRM: I can see the song in my OBS / Streamlabs scene.
SETUP_TEST_HINT: Start the test, then send a song link with !sr in one of your linked chats. This is a real request and may change your music queue.
SETUP_TEST_LINK_HINT: Replace the example with a complete link to a song on your selected service.
SETUP_REQUEST_WAIT: Listening for five minutes. Send your request in chat now.
SETUP_REQUEST_ACCEPTED: A real chat request was accepted.
SETUP_REQUEST_FAILED: A request reached the client but needs attention. Check the response below, correct it, and try again.
SETUP_APPROVE_HINT: If your request is waiting in the Request+ queue, send it to the player here. Let it play next, or skip the current song in your music app, then check the overlay.
SETUP_REQUEST_CONFIRM: I hear the requested song and can see it in my stream overlay.
SETUP_TEST_TROUBLESHOOT: No response? Check the linked channel and bot permissions. YouTube needs an active live chat. Enable requests and use an account allowed by your rules. If five minutes pass, restart this test.
SETUP_COPY_FAILED: Could not copy the overlay file path. Try again or select and copy the path manually.
SETUP_GUIDE_UNKNOWN: Choose a player above to configure a single music source. Your existing selection is kept until you choose another player.
